sources.title: Soulfate24/AutoRound-ASHQ1_Double-Quantization_Suite · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The AutoRound + ASHQ1 Suite delivers a complete pipeline for creating ultra-high-fidelity GGUF models. By combining gradient-guided weight reorganization (AutoRound W4A16) with fine-grained activation-aware tensor assignment (ASHQ1 Imatrix Engine), this suite establishes a new standard for low-bit LLM compression.

sources.title: How to Run Ornith 1.5 9B Locally: GGUF, Hardware and Benchmarks
sources.snippet: How to Run Ornith 1.5 9B Locally: GGUF, Hardware and Benchmarks Ornith 1.5 9B is the model from DeepReinforce's new Ornith 1.5 family that you can actually run locally: a dense 9B multimodal coding model that fits on an 8 GB GPU or a 16 GB Mac at 4-bit quantization.

sources.title: Ornith-1.5-9B · LLM Releases
sources.snippet: The smallest model in DeepReinforce's Ornith-1.5 family (released 2026-08-19, MIT, weights on Hugging Face): a 9B-parameter dense coding/agent model trained with the family's self-improving task-and-scaffold RL loop, and shipped with a quantized 'Ornith-1.5-9B-Mobile' build that runs on iPhone and Android.
